subject: Retroactive metering cascade — request for ledger proof & VAT split
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@lumena.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Alex Novak <alex.novak@lumena.com>
Date: 2028-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Unexpected Feb charges — ledger and VAT split question

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking a look. We noticed a large jump on our February statement (invoice attached) tied to a short burst on 2028-02-28 that generated ~56M extra embed tokens. Our engineering team dug into our side and found a retry loop that produced duplicate requests for ~2 hours. We understand that some duplication falls to the customer, but the pattern looks like a retry cascade that was caused by a transient edge error on your side earlier that day (we've highlighted the window in lumena_ledger_snippet.csv).

Two urgent asks:
- Can you provide per-requestid evidence (server-side logs / token attribution) that supports the charge vs. duplicated traffic? We need this for our finance team and our auditors.
- VAT handling: Lumena bills from two EU entities (Lumena NL and Lumena DE). If you credit the duplicated tokens, we need to know how you will issue the credit note and whether VAT will be reversed or reallocated across the entities.

We'd like to resolve before our close on 2028-03-25. Can you confirm receipt and the next steps?

Best,
Samantha Lee
VP Finance | Lumena
Samantha.Lee@lumena.com
+44 7911 555 012

Attachment: invoice_20280228.pdf (PDF, 128KB); lumena_ledger_snippet.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Unexpected Feb charges — ledger and VAT split question

Team — forwarding Lumena's request. TL;DR: 56M extra embed tokens flagged; they claim a retry cascade (client-side) but say there was an edge error. They want per-requestid evidence and clarity on VAT/credit note handling across their EU entities.

Can ops/billing confirm:
- Can we extract per-requestid attribution for the 2028-02-28 08:00–10:00 UTC window and produce a CSV with request_id, model, token_count, route (hosted/dedicated)?
- Do we have an internal policy for credits when a client-side retry storm is partially triggered by a transient server error? If we credit, what's the calculation for the token credit and how do we handle VAT for multiple EU entities?

Suggested next steps: Marissa, pull the per-request evidence and a quick calculation (gross token delta + proposed credit amount). Grace / Ben please advise on VAT mechanics and whether we need Lumena's VAT IDs to reissue.

I will loop back to Samantha with a plan today (they asked for resolution by 2028-03-25).

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Customer Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-19T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Unexpected Feb charges — ledger and VAT split question

On Mon, Mar 18, 2028 at 10:03 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — forwarding Lumena's request. TL;DR: 56M extra embed tokens flagged; they claim a retry cascade (client-side) but say there was an edge error.

Investigated and here's what we can provide quickly: per-request attribution for the window is available from our telemetry export. I pulled a sample (attached: lumena_ledger_snippet.csv) and ran a dedup check. Preliminary findings:
- Total tokens billed in 2028-02-28 08:00–10:00 UTC: 62,142,900 tokens
- Unique request tokens (post-dedup heuristic): 16,782,300 tokens
- Delta (likely duplicated/retries): 45,360,600 tokens

Credit policy note: our guideline allows discretionary credits when >30% of a customer's traffic in a contiguous window is attributable to duplicated requests and there is evidence of a platform fault or error. I see repeated 5xx bursts from our edge at 2028-02-28 07:58–08:05 UTC (error spike id EDGE-20280228-58). That aligns with Lumena's window and justifies a partial credit.

Proposed credit math (gross):
- Duplicate tokens: 45,360,600 tokens
- Effective rate (their plan): €0.00042 per embed token
- Gross credit before VAT: €19,051.45

VAT handling options (need Lumena confirmation):
1) Lumena provides the billing VAT ID per entity. We issue a credit note for the gross amount and reissue the corrected invoice(s) allocating net amounts to the correct EU entities. If Lumena is reverse-charge eligible, VAT will not be re-applied.
2) If they decline to provide VAT IDs, we can issue a credit and re-bill with VAT per our default EU tax rules (may affect cash).

Attachments: lumena_ledger_snippet.csv (sample export), invoice_calc_20280319.xlsx (calculation workbook). I can produce the full per-request CSV if legal/ops approve sharing.

Next: Grace/Ben — confirm VAT flow and whether legal needs to sign off on sharing per-request logs containing potential PII. If OK, we'll send proposed credit and ask for VAT IDs.

-M
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@lumena.com>, Alex Novak <alex.novak@lumena.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-20T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected Feb charges — ledger and VAT split question

Samantha — thanks for your patience and for the ledger extract. We investigated and have a concrete remediation path. Apologies for the disruption.

Summary of findings:
- Our telemetry shows an edge 5xx spike (EDGE-20280228-58) at ~07:58–08:05 UTC that coincides with Lumena's retries.
- After deduplication heuristics, ~45.36M tokens appear duplicated and attributable to a retry cascade.

Operational proposal:
1) Credit: We will issue a gross credit of €19,051.45 to Lumena for the duplicated tokens.
2) VAT: To allocate the credit without causing tax mismatch, please confirm the billing entity and VAT ID you want the credit applied to (Lumena NL or Lumena DE). If you elect reverse-charge and provide the VAT IDs, we will reissue the adjusted invoice(s) net of VAT. Otherwise, we'll issue a credit note and re-bill under our standard EU VAT rules.
3) Evidence: Attached is the sample CSV and a short calculation workbook. If you need the full per-request export for audit, Marissa can provide it under a DPA amendment — please indicate who will sign.

Proposed next steps and timeline:
- Confirm preferred billing entity + VAT ID by 2028-03-23.
- We will issue the credit note and updated invoice(s) by 2028-03-25 once we have your confirmation.
- If you want a quick sync to walk the logs, I'm available 2028-03-21 10:00–13:00 UTC.

Again, apologies for the inconvenience. We're also opening an internal incident to prevent similar retry cascades and will share a short post-mortem.

Best regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Customer Finance | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachment: lumena_ledger_snippet.csv (CSV, 12KB); invoice_calc_20280319.xlsx (XLSX, 36KB); vat_entity_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 8KB)
